title: A Deep Case for Shallow Integration
title_zh: 浅层整合的深层论证
title_primary: 浅层整合的深层论证
title_secondary: A Deep Case for Shallow Integration
authors: John Sturm Becko, Arnaud Costinot
official: 官方在线 2026-08-31 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study international cooperation in a general environment with pecuniary and non-pecuniary externalities across countries. We derive two main theorems, each demonstrating that market-access commitments, a form of shallow integration, are sufficient to implement globally efficient policies. When all cross-border externalities are pecuniary, the first theorem provides a new and unifying perspective on a series of results by Bagwell and Staiger. When some cross-border externalities are non-pecuniary, the second theorem shows that market-access commitments, properly extended, still sustain global efficiency. These extended market-access commitments reinterpret cross-border externalities as additional goods that are traded and priced at their social values. We discuss the implications for international cooperation on climate change and geopolitics.
abstract_zh: 我们研究在存在跨国金钱性外部性与非金钱性外部性的普遍环境中的国际合作。我们推导出两个主要定理，各自证明市场准入承诺——一种浅层一体化形式——足以实施全球高效政策。当所有跨境外部性均为金钱性时，第一个定理为巴格韦尔和斯泰格的一系列结果提供了新的统一视角。当部分跨境外部性为非金钱性时，第二个定理表明，适当扩展的市场准入承诺仍能维持全球效率。这些扩展的市场准入承诺将跨境外部性重新解释为按其社会价值交易和定价的额外商品。我们讨论了这些发现对气候变化和地缘政治国际合作的启示。

title: Matrix Quantile Factor Model
title_zh: 矩阵分位数因子模型
title_primary: 矩阵分位数因子模型
title_secondary: Matrix Quantile Factor Model
authors: Xinbing Kong, Yongxin Liu, Long Yu, Peng Zhao
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-25 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper introduces a matrix quantile factor model for matrix-valued data with low-rank structure. We estimate the row and column factor spaces via minimizing the empirical check loss function with orthogonal rotation constraints. We show that the estimates converge at rate (min{p1p2,p2T,p1T})−1/2 in the average Frobenius norm, where p1, p2 and T are the row dimensionality, column dimensionality and length of the matrix sequence, respectively. This rate is faster than that of the quantile estimates via “flattening" the matrix model into a large vector model. To establish the central limit theorem, we introduce a tricky augmented Lagrangian function, which is equivalent to the original constrained empirical check loss minimization problem. Via the equivalence, we prove that the Hessian matrix of the augmented Lagrangian function is locally positive definite, resulting in a locally convex penalized loss function around the true factors and their loadings. This easily leads to a feasible second-order expansion of the score function and readily established central limit theorems of the smoothed estimates of the loadings. We provide three consistent criteria to determine the pair of row and column factor numbers. Extensive simulation studies and an empirical study justify our theory.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种适用于具有低秩结构的矩阵值数据的矩阵分位数因子模型。我们通过最小化带有正交旋转约束的经验检查损失函数来估计行与列因子空间。研究表明，在平均Frobenius范数下，估计值的收敛速度为(min{p1p2,p2T,p1T})−1/2，其中p1、p2和T分别代表矩阵序列的行维度、列维度和长度。这一速度优于将矩阵模型“扁平化”为大型向量模型后的分位数估计速度。为建立中心极限定理，我们引入了一个巧妙的增广拉格朗日函数，该函数与原始带约束的经验检查损失最小化问题等价。通过这种等价性，我们证明了增广拉格朗日函数的Hessian矩阵在局部是正定的，从而在真实因子及其载荷周围产生一个局部凸的惩罚损失函数。这便于得到得分函数的可行二阶展开，并顺利建立载荷平滑估计的中心极限定理。我们提供了三种一致准则来确定行与列因子数的配对。广泛的模拟研究和一项实证研究验证了我们的理论。

title: Variety and Agglomeration in Financial Markets
title_zh: 金融市场的多样性与集聚
title_primary: 金融市场的多样性与集聚
title_secondary: Variety and Agglomeration in Financial Markets
authors: Ana Babus
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Financial markets are highly differentiated: firms issue many products beyond stocks and bonds. This variety is consequential because the products firms use determine which issuers raise capital, on what terms, and which risks investors absorb. We propose a model of variety and firms’ allocation across products. Products repackage firms’ cash flows and differ in expected payoff per unit of exposure to aggregate risk and firm-specific risk passed to investors. Aggregate exposure raises the compensation all issuers must offer, whereas firm-specific risk lowers only the issuing firm’s payoff. We show that specialized products coexist with widely adopted ones through trade-offs between these two dimensions.
abstract_zh: 金融市场高度分化：企业发行的产品远不止股票和债券。这种多样性意义重大，因为企业所使用的产品决定了哪些发行者能筹集资本、以何种条件筹集，以及投资者承担哪些风险。我们提出了一个关于产品多样性及企业跨产品配置的模型。产品重新组合企业的现金流，并在传递给投资者的总体风险和企业特定风险的单位暴露预期回报上存在差异。总体暴露提高了所有发行者必须提供的补偿，而企业特定风险仅降低发行企业自身的回报。我们证明，专业化产品与广泛采用的产品通过这两个维度之间的权衡而共存。

title: Short-term political memory and the inevitability of polarisation
title_zh: 短期政治记忆与两极分化的必然性
title_primary: 短期政治记忆与两极分化的必然性
title_secondary: Short-term political memory and the inevitability of polarisation
authors: Gilat Levy, Ronny Razin
official: 官方在线 2021-11-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: In this paper we explore the effect of short memories on political outcomes in a model in which politics is viewed as a collective learning process . We analyse a dynamic model in which voters use past observations to learn about the optimal policy and political parties are self-interested, with polarised ideal policies. Voters balance party loyalty with a desire to vote for the party whose policy is based on a better interpretation of past observations. We show that short-term memory leads to political cycles of polarisation and convergence. Historical periods of convergence lead parties to polarise, whereas periods of polarisation imply convergence of platforms. Our framework also allows us to model the strategic use of biased histories and narratives in political competition, such as the use of nostalgia.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在将政治视为集体学习过程的模型中，短期记忆对政治结果的影响。我们分析了一个动态模型，其中选民利用过去的观察来学习最优政策，而政党则追求自身利益，拥有两极化的理想政策。选民在政党忠诚与投票给基于对过去观察更佳解读的政党之间寻求平衡。我们表明，短期记忆导致政治极化与趋同的周期循环。历史上的趋同期促使政党走向极化，而极化期则意味着政纲的趋同。我们的框架还允许我们模拟政治竞争中偏见历史和叙事的策略性使用，例如怀旧情绪的运用。

title: Rails of Progress? Exploring the Nexus between Railroad Access and Innovation in Italy (19th-20th Centuries)
title_zh: 进步的轨道？铁路通达与意大利创新之间的关联探析（19至20世纪）
title_primary: 进步的轨道？铁路通达与意大利创新之间的关联探析（19至20世纪）
title_secondary: Rails of Progress? Exploring the Nexus between Railroad Access and Innovation in Italy (19th-20th Centuries)
authors: Marco Martinez, Alessandro Nuvolari, Michelangelo Vasta, Dino Pinelli, Michele Leonardo Bianchi 等
official: 官方在线 2024-12-24 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper provides new evidence on the nexus between railroads and inventive activities in Italy in the period 1861-1936. We develop two new georeferenced datasets on railway stations and patents. By adopting the staggered difference in differences identification strategy by Callaway and Sant’Anna (2021), we show that the impact of railroad construction on innovation is only visible for the first wave of construction of the period of the Destra storica (1861-1878), when the network was expanded following a state building strategy. However, these effects became noticeable only after more than two decades and concern mostly independent inventors and low-quality patents.
abstract_zh: 本文为1861-1936年间意大利铁路建设与发明活动之间的关联提供了新的证据。我们构建了两个新的地理参照数据集，分别涉及火车站和专利。采用Callaway和Sant’Anna（2021）提出的交错差分识别策略，我们表明铁路建设对创新的影响仅在“历史右翼”时期（1861-1878）的第一波建设浪潮中显现，当时铁路网络的扩展遵循了国家建设战略。然而，这些效应在二十多年后才变得显著，且主要涉及独立发明者和低质量专利。

title: Personal Holding Companies, Tax Progressivity, and Inequality
title_zh: 个人控股公司、税收累进性与不平等
title_primary: 个人控股公司、税收累进性与不平等
title_secondary: Personal Holding Companies, Tax Progressivity, and Inequality
authors: Marius A. K. Ring, David G. Seim, Gabriel Zucman
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Tax avoidance through personal holding companies has long been viewed as a key challenge for progressive income taxation. We exploit twenty years of administrative micro-data linking firms to owners in Sweden and Norway to analyze how the use of personal holding companies varies across the income distribution and to quantify its implications in a quasi-experimental setting. About half of the income of the top 0.1% is retained in personal holding companies defined, as in US tax law, as firms for which five or fewer owners own more than 50% of the stock and that derive more than 60% of income from investment income. Event studies of shocks to operational firms’ value-added show that holding companies shield around half of dividend distributions from individual income taxation. Profits tend to remain in holding companies for long periods of time, with cumulative payout rates of 15%–20% over two decades for the highest income groups. Wealth taxes do not provide an effective backstop due to the low valuation (or exemption) of shares in private businesses. As a result, effective tax rates, all taxes included, fall from about 50% for the upper middle class to about 15%–20% among the highest-net-worth individuals. Accounting for income in holding companies erases half of the difference in the 1980–2020 rise of the top 1% fiscal income share between Nordic countries and the United States, where rules penalizing the use of holding companies have been in place since the 1930s.
abstract_zh: 通过个人控股公司避税长期以来被视为累进所得税制面临的关键挑战。我们利用瑞典和挪威二十年来将企业与所有者关联的行政微观数据，分析个人控股公司的使用如何随收入分配变化，并在准实验环境中量化其影响。根据美国税法定义，个人控股公司指由不超过五名所有者持有超过50%股份、且超过60%收入来源于投资收入的企业。在最高收入前0.1%群体中，约半数收入留存于此类公司。对运营企业增加值冲击的事件研究表明，控股公司约将半数股息分配从个人所得税中屏蔽。利润往往长期留存于控股公司，最高收入群体二十年累计派息率仅为15%-20%。由于私人企业股份估值偏低（或享受豁免），财富税无法提供有效补充。因此，包含所有税种在内的实际税率，从中上阶层的约50%降至最高净值人群的约15%-20%。若将控股公司收入纳入统计，1980-2020年间北欧国家与美国的顶层1%财政性收入份额增长差异将缩小一半——美国自1930年代起便实施限制控股公司使用的规则。

title: Intellectual Property Rights and Entry into a Foreign Market: FDI vs Joint Ventures
title_zh: 知识产权与进入外国市场：外商直接投资与合资企业的选择
title_primary: 知识产权与进入外国市场：外商直接投资与合资企业的选择
title_secondary: Intellectual Property Rights and Entry into a Foreign Market: FDI vs Joint Ventures
authors: Dermot Leahy, Alireza Naghavi, Daron Acemoglu, Ufuk Akcigit, Simon Johnson 等
official: 官方在线 2006-05-10 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper investigates how the mode of entry into a foreign market can be influenced by the intensity of R&D in an industry and the protection of intellectual property rights (IPR) in a recipient country. It then analyzes the link between the IPR regime and policies that place limits on the degree of foreign ownership in a joint venture (JV). In particular, we study the effect of the IPR regime of the host country (South) on a multinational?s decision between serving a market via greenfield foreign direct investment to avoid the exposure of its technology or entering a JV with a local firm, which allows R&D spillovers to a third firm under imperfect IPRs. JV is the equilibrium market structure when extra rents can be gained from a JV. This occurs when R&D intensity is moderate and IPRs strong. The South can gain from increased IPR protection by encouraging a JV, whereas policies to limit foreign ownership in a JV gain importance in technology intensive industries as complementary policies to strong IPRs. The South never finds it optimal to fully protect IPRs and concede all bargaining power in a JV to the Northern firm.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了行业研发强度与东道国知识产权保护如何影响企业进入外国市场的模式，进而分析了知识产权制度与限制合资企业中外资持股比例政策之间的关联。具体而言，我们考察了东道国（南方国家）的知识产权制度对跨国公司决策的影响——即选择通过绿地外商直接投资进入市场以避免技术泄露，还是与当地企业组建合资企业（在知识产权保护不完善的情况下，该模式可能导致研发溢出至第三方企业）。当合资企业能产生额外租金时，其将成为均衡市场结构，这一情形出现在研发强度适中且知识产权保护较强的条件下。南方国家可通过强化知识产权保护鼓励合资企业模式获益，而在技术密集型产业中，限制合资企业外资持股比例的政策作为强知识产权保护的补充手段愈发重要。研究发现，南方国家永远不会选择完全保护知识产权，也不会将合资企业中的所有议价权让渡给北方企业。

title: A strategic analysis of narcoterrorism: counterterrorism, terrorist extortion, and illicit drug trafficking
title_zh: 毒品恐怖主义的战略分析：反恐、恐怖勒索与非法毒品贩运
title_primary: 毒品恐怖主义的战略分析：反恐、恐怖勒索与非法毒品贩运
title_secondary: A strategic analysis of narcoterrorism: counterterrorism, terrorist extortion, and illicit drug trafficking
authors: Subhayu Bandyopadhyay, Todd Sandler
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The paper presents a novel strategic analysis of narcoterrorism where a weak developing country’s terrorist group extorts home drug farmers to finance terror attacks. A developed country’s counterterror actions are motivated by the harm its residents endure from those attacks. The developed country’s counterterrorism involves efforts to destroy the drug crop abroad. The analysis begins with the drug price being exogenously fixed, followed by a “large-country case’’ with a market-determined drug price. The extension introduces a fourth participant, consisting of the developed country’s consumers whose purchases determine the drug demand. A subsequent extension allows for two drug-exporting countries along with their resident terrorist groups. Now, the drug price depends on terrorists’ extortion rates and the developed country’s counterterrorism associated with the two drug-exporting countries. With the last extension, novel drug-based counterterror transfers of terrorism occur between the drug-producing countries. For alternative scenarios, we show the key influence of the elasticity of the farmers’ counterterror resilience on the extortion rate and terrorism level.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种关于毒品恐怖主义的新战略分析，其中，一个弱小发展中国家的恐怖组织通过勒索本国毒品农民来资助恐怖袭击。发达国家的反恐行动源于其居民因这些袭击所遭受的伤害。该发达国家的反恐措施包括努力在海外摧毁毒品作物。分析首先假设毒品价格外生固定，随后探讨“大国情形”，即毒品价格由市场决定。扩展部分引入第四方参与者，即发达国家的消费者，其购买行为决定毒品需求。进一步的扩展允许存在两个毒品出口国及其各自的恐怖组织。此时，毒品价格取决于恐怖分子的勒索率以及发达国家针对这两个毒品出口国的反恐行动。通过最后的扩展，毒品生产国之间出现了基于毒品的新型反恐恐怖转移。针对不同情景，我们展示了农民反恐韧性弹性对勒索率和恐怖主义水平的关键影响。

title: Inside the Black Box: Advancing Climate Disclosure in Australia's Energy Sector to Support a Resilient National Electricity Market
title_zh: 黑箱之内：推进澳大利亚能源行业气候披露以支持韧性国家电力市场
title_primary: 黑箱之内：推进澳大利亚能源行业气候披露以支持韧性国家电力市场
title_secondary: Inside the Black Box: Advancing Climate Disclosure in Australia's Energy Sector to Support a Resilient National Electricity Market
authors: Tracey Dodd, Melissa Nursey‐Bray, Rhys Thomas
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Alongside the 2024–2025 review of the National Electricity Market, Australian energy companies faced the most significant reforms to climate disclosures in corporate history. Specifically, the Australian Sustainability Reporting Standard for Climate‐related Disclosures (AASB S2) was announced in September 2024, after which all entities falling within the purview of the National Greenhouse and Energy Reporting Act—effectively every major electricity generator and retailer—were required to identify and disclose climate‐related risks and opportunities. This includes Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions and scenario analysis of their exposure to climate disruptions. Whilst some energy companies had already voluntarily disclosed some elements of this information, these new requirements required more consistent, comparable and forward‐looking reporting. We examine the early stages of measures taken by the energy sector to comply with AASB S2. Drawing on a 12‐month collaboration with the Australian Energy Council, our case study highlights the need for greater attention to robust methodologies for calculating Scope 3 emissions and stress testing climate scenarios, including the policy assumptions that underpin them. Importantly, this research highlights the risks inherent to any national standard that is more closely aligned to policy aspirations than to climate science, given that such discrepancies may pose risks to the resilience of the National Electricity Market. This study also contributes to stakeholder theory by illustrating the need for greater attention to how sector‐level collaboration among competitors can support improved corporate disclosures, especially in relation to climate governance.
abstract_zh: 在2024-2025年国家电力市场审查期间，澳大利亚能源企业面临企业史上最重大的气候信息披露改革。具体而言，2024年9月发布的《澳大利亚气候相关披露可持续性报告准则》（AASB S2）要求所有受《国家温室与能源报告法》管辖的实体——实际上涵盖所有主要电力生产商和零售商——必须识别并披露气候相关风险与机遇，包括范围1、2、3排放及其对气候干扰暴露度的情景分析。尽管部分能源企业此前已自愿披露部分信息，但新规要求更一致、可比且具有前瞻性的报告。本研究考察了能源行业为遵守AASB S2所采取措施的早期阶段。基于与澳大利亚能源委员会为期12个月的合作，我们的案例研究强调需更加关注范围3排放计算的稳健方法论及气候情景压力测试（包括其政策假设）。重要的是，本研究揭示了任何更贴近政策愿景而非气候科学的国家标准所固有的风险——此类偏差可能危及国家电力市场的韧性。此外，本研究通过阐明竞争者之间的行业层面协作如何支持企业信息披露改进（尤其在气候治理领域），为利益相关者理论作出贡献。

title: Generative AI and Data Quality: Implications for Productivity, Labor Displacement, and Policy
title_zh: 生成式人工智能与数据质量：对生产率、劳动力替代及政策的影响
title_primary: 生成式人工智能与数据质量：对生产率、劳动力替代及政策的影响
title_secondary: Generative AI and Data Quality: Implications for Productivity, Labor Displacement, and Policy
authors: Zhifeng Cai
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-13 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly consuming and producing huge amounts of data. We propose a social learning model of AI, emphasizing a data-AI feedback loop: data quality affects AI productivity, which influences AI adoption and, consequently, the composition (AI versus human-generated) and quality of future data. Calibrated to evidence on synthetic training loops, the model predicts hump-shaped labor dynamics—short-term displacement that partially reverses as data quality deteriorates. A Grossman–Stiglitz-style externality emerges: AI adopters free-ride on the human-generated actions that supply the novel information on which AI itself relies. In a competitive market, AI should be taxed to correct the data-quality externality; a concentrated AI industry overcorrects, making a subsidy optimal. (JEL O33, D62, D83, J24)
abstract_zh: 摘要 生成式人工智能正日益消耗并产生海量数据。我们提出一个关于人工智能的社会学习模型，强调数据与人工智能之间的反馈循环：数据质量影响人工智能的生产力，进而影响人工智能的采用，并最终决定未来数据的构成（人工智能生成与人类生成）及其质量。基于合成训练循环的证据进行校准后，该模型预测劳动力动态呈驼峰形——短期替代效应会随着数据质量恶化而部分逆转。一种格罗斯曼-斯蒂格利茨式外部性由此产生：人工智能采用者搭便车，依赖人类生成的行为提供人工智能自身所需的新信息。在竞争性市场中，应对人工智能征税以纠正数据质量外部性；而集中化的人工智能行业则会过度纠正，使得补贴成为最优选择。（JEL O33, D62, D83, J24）

abstract: How households behave in an environment with deposit rates below zero is important for monetary transmission, but the literature is scant. This column studies household behaviour in the context of a major episode of negative interest rates in Denmark. This authors find that the negative deposit rates led to a strong decrease in deposits. Households appear to react more sharply when interest rates below zero are cut compared to when rates are positive. As depositors seem to consume more rather than hold more cash, policy rate cuts in negative territory may have particularly strong consumption effects.
abstract_zh: 家庭在存款利率为负的环境中的行为对货币传导至关重要，但相关文献较为匮乏。本文以丹麦负利率重大事件为背景，研究家庭行为。作者发现，负存款利率导致存款大幅减少。与正利率时期相比，当利率降至负值区间时，家庭反应更为剧烈。由于储户似乎更倾向于增加消费而非持有更多现金，负利率区间的政策利率下调可能对消费产生尤为显著的影响。

abstract: We used a preregistered incentivized online experiment to examine whether unfair treatment increases dishonesty toward uninvolved third parties and whether observers anticipate such effects. Unfairly treated participants were not significantly more likely to lie for personal gain. In contrast, spectators were nearly twice as likely to bet that unfairly treated participants would lie and judged such lying as more morally acceptable following unfair treatment. These patterns provide preliminary evidence of a sizeable belief–behavior gap in expectations about how unfairness influences dishonesty.
abstract_zh: 我们通过一项预先注册的激励性在线实验，考察了不公平对待是否会增加对无关第三方的不诚实行为，以及观察者是否能预见到这种效应。遭受不公平对待的参与者并未显著更倾向于为个人利益而撒谎。相反，旁观者押注遭受不公平对待的参与者会撒谎的可能性几乎翻倍，并认为在不公平对待后此类撒谎行为在道德上更可接受。这些模式初步揭示了关于不公平如何影响不诚实行为的信念与行为之间存在显著差距的证据。

title: What Jobs Come to Mind? Stereotypes About Fields of Study
title_zh: 想到什么工作？关于学科领域的刻板印象
title_primary: 想到什么工作？关于学科领域的刻板印象
title_secondary: What Jobs Come to Mind? Stereotypes About Fields of Study
authors: John J Conlon, Dev Patel
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We test for stereotyping—the exaggeration of representative traits—in a high-stakes economic environment. Using both surveys administered among undergraduates at the Ohio State University and large-scale nationally representative data, we measure how US freshmen perceive the relationship between college majors and occupations. We show that students greatly overestimate the likelihood that majors lead to their representative jobs (e.g., counselor for psychology, journalist for journalism). Using an implicit association test, we show that students associate majors with their representative careers and that these associations strongly predict belief biases, in line with a stereotyping mechanism. A simple equilibrium model of the labor market predicts that stereotyping reduces welfare by increasing misallocation, which correlational evidence on job/major mismatch corroborates. In a field experiment, we test a light-touch policy to reduce stereotyping and find significant effects on students’ intentions about what to study as well as the classes and majors they enroll in.
abstract_zh: 摘要 我们检验了高 stakes 经济环境中的刻板印象——即对代表性特征的夸大。通过俄亥俄州立大学本科生调查及大规模全国代表性数据，我们测量了美国新生对大学专业与职业之间关系的认知。研究表明，学生极大高估了专业导向其代表性职业的可能性（例如心理学专业对应咨询师、新闻学专业对应记者）。通过内隐联想测试，我们发现学生将专业与其代表性职业相关联，且这些关联强烈预测信念偏差，这与刻板印象机制一致。一个简单的劳动力市场均衡模型预测，刻板印象通过加剧资源错配降低社会福利，而关于职业/专业错配的相关证据证实了这一点。在实地实验中，我们测试了一项轻触式政策以减少刻板印象，发现该政策对学生学习意向、所选课程及专业注册产生了显著影响。

title: Do Wage Floors Increase Employment Risk for Workers with Disabilities? Evidence from Minimum Wage Increases and Subminimum Wage Repeal
title_zh: 最低工资标准是否增加了残疾工人的就业风险？来自最低工资上调与次最低工资废除的证据

title_secondary: Do Wage Floors Increase Employment Risk for Workers with Disabilities? Evidence from Minimum Wage Increases and Subminimum Wage Repeal
authors: Roisin O'Neill, Shailee Manandhar, Douglas L. Kruse
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: People with disabilities are disproportionately represented in low-wage work, raising concerns that higher wage floors may reduce their employment opportunities, particularly for workers with more severe disabilities. We examine the effects of state minimum wage increases and state subminimum wage terminations on employment outcomes for people with disabilities using American Community Survey data from 2010–2023. We find little evidence that minimum wage increases reduce employment or labor force participation among people with disabilities, including those with more severe disabilities. While many estimates are statistically imprecise, confidence intervals generally rule out economically meaningful negative employment effects. We likewise find no evidence that terminating subminimum wages reduces employment opportunities for affected workers, and some estimates suggest positive employment effects for groups most likely to have been employed under subminimum wage arrangements. These gains may reflect complementary policies that often accompany repeal, such as Employment First initiatives. Overall, the results provide little support for the view that higher wage floors create disproportionate employment barriers for people with disabilities.
abstract_zh: 残疾人在低薪工作中占比过高，这引发担忧：更高的工资下限可能减少其就业机会，尤其是对残疾程度更重的劳动者。我们利用2010-2023年美国社区调查数据，研究各州最低工资上调及取消次级最低工资对残疾人就业结果的影响。研究发现，几乎没有证据表明最低工资上调会降低残疾人（包括重度残疾者）的就业率或劳动参与率。尽管许多估计值在统计上不够精确，但置信区间通常排除了具有经济意义的负面就业效应。同样，我们未发现取消次级最低工资会减少受影响劳动者的就业机会，部分估计甚至表明，最可能受次级最低工资制度影响的群体出现了积极就业效应。这些改善可能源于伴随废除政策实施的配套措施（如“就业优先”计划）。总体而言，研究结果不支持“更高工资下限会为残疾人制造不成比例的就业障碍”这一观点。

title: Income Mobility of the Top One Percent
title_zh: 顶层百分之一的收入流动性
title_primary: 顶层百分之一的收入流动性
title_secondary: Income Mobility of the Top One Percent
authors: David Splinter, Jeff Larrimore
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Circulation into and out of the top one percent is pronounced in the U.S. One third exit after a year and two-thirds exit after a decade. This mobility lowers top income shares when shifting from annual to multi-year income measures. Intragenerational mobility over two decades lowers recent top one percent fiscal income shares by over 10 percent. Two-decade mobility reduces top 0.1% shares by over 20 percent, top 0.01% shares by 30 percent, and top 0.001% shares by 40 percent. Effects of variability on wealth inequality are similar in magnitude, although more modest as a share of top wealth inequality.
abstract_zh: 美国收入前1%群体的流入与流出变动显著：一年后三分之一退出，十年后三分之二退出。这种流动性在将收入衡量周期从年度扩展至多年时，会降低顶层收入份额。二十年的代内流动性使近期前1%的财政总收入份额下降超过10%，前0.1%份额下降超过20%，前0.01%份额下降30%，前0.001%份额下降40%。收入波动对财富不平等的影响幅度与之相似，但就顶层财富不平等占比而言更为温和。

title: Reconciling Micro Elasticities with the Macro Decline in Labor Supply
title_zh: 协调微观弹性与宏观劳动供给下降
title_primary: 协调微观弹性与宏观劳动供给下降
title_secondary: Reconciling Micro Elasticities with the Macro Decline in Labor Supply
authors: Loukas Karabarbounis
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Micro estimates of the Marshallian elasticity of labor supply are small and typically positive, whereas cross-country and time-series patterns of hours imply a strong negative relationship between wages and hours. I reconcile these two apparently contradictory observations using a single utility specification and taking into account heterogeneity in non-labor income. Micro estimates condition on non-labor income, while macro variation allows capital income to adjust alongside labor income, which strengthens the income effect. A model with heterogeneous households and exogenous capital income yields closed-form expressions in which the distribution of the labor share shapes the gap between the micro and the macro elasticities. A cross-sectional regression of hours on wages that conditions on the labor share recovers the macro elasticity. A dynamic model with heterogeneous households and incomplete asset markets reproduces both elasticities as outcomes when disciplined by joint moments of wages, hours, consumption, and wealth. The income effects that bridge the gap between the two elasticities imply marginal propensities to earn that lie in the range of estimates of micro studies on lottery winners.
abstract_zh: 马歇尔劳动供给弹性的微观估计值较小且通常为正，而跨国与时间序列的工作时长模式则显示工资与工作时长之间存在强烈的负相关关系。本文通过单一效用函数设定并考虑非劳动收入的异质性，调和了这两种看似矛盾的观测结果。微观估计以非劳动收入为条件，而宏观变化则允许资本收入与劳动收入同步调整，从而强化了收入效应。一个包含异质性家庭与外生资本收入的模型可推导出闭式表达式，其中劳动收入份额的分布决定了微观弹性与宏观弹性之间的差距。以劳动收入份额为条件的横截面工作时长-工资回归能够还原宏观弹性。一个包含异质性家庭与不完全资产市场的动态模型，在工资、工作时长、消费与财富的联合矩约束下，可同时再现两种弹性。弥合两种弹性差距的收入效应意味着边际收入倾向处于彩票中奖者微观研究的估计区间内。

title: Does school lunch equalize? An examination of dietary quality and socioeconomic disparities in Germany
title_zh: 学校午餐能否实现平等？德国膳食质量与社会经济差异的考察
title_primary: 学校午餐能否实现平等？德国膳食质量与社会经济差异的考察
title_secondary: Does school lunch equalize? An examination of dietary quality and socioeconomic disparities in Germany
authors: Vicky Heijnk, Sebastian Hess, Anja Simmet
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: An adequate diet is essential for children’s cognitive, physical, and educational development, yet children from lower socioeconomic backgrounds are more likely to have poorer dietary quality, reinforcing social inequalities. This study examines whether the offer of school lunch can mitigate the effect of socioeconomic status on children’s total daily dietary quality. Using food frequency data from the second wave of the German KiGGS study (2014–2017), we construct an updated Healthy Nutrition Score for Kids and Youth (HuSKY) to capture overall dietary quality in a single measure. We focus on children between 6 and 13 years and proxy school lunch using attendance at after-school care facilities that typically offer school lunch. To address potential selection bias between children with and without such a lunch offer, we apply propensity score matching. We then estimate a mixed-effects model on the matched sample (n = 2,212) to analyze the effects of socioeconomic status, school lunch offer, and their interaction on total daily dietary quality. Our results corroborate that dietary quality is higher among children with higher socioeconomic status and is also positively associated with receiving a school lunch offer. Beyond supporting prior findings, we find that the positive association between socioeconomic status and dietary quality is substantially weaker among children receiving a school lunch offer. Accordingly, we conclude that school lunch may help reduce socioeconomic disparities in dietary quality. Future research should examine whether these improvements help reduce broader inequalities in health, education, and income. Policymakers should consider these potential benefits in the ongoing debate surrounding (free) school lunch provision.
abstract_zh: 充足的饮食对儿童的认知、身体及教育发展至关重要，然而社会经济背景较低的儿童往往饮食质量较差，这加剧了社会不平等。本研究探讨学校午餐供应是否能缓解社会经济地位对儿童每日总体饮食质量的影响。利用德国KiGGS研究第二波（2014-2017年）的食物频率数据，我们构建了更新版的儿童与青少年健康营养评分（HuSKY），以单一指标衡量整体饮食质量。研究对象为6至13岁的儿童，并以通常提供学校午餐的课后托管机构出勤情况作为学校午餐的代理变量。为处理有无此类午餐供应的儿童之间可能存在的选择偏差，我们采用倾向得分匹配方法。随后，在匹配样本（n=2,212）上估计混合效应模型，分析社会经济地位、学校午餐供应及其交互作用对每日总体饮食质量的影响。结果证实，社会经济地位较高的儿童饮食质量更高，且学校午餐供应与饮食质量呈正相关。在支持先前研究发现的基础上，我们发现，在接受学校午餐供应的儿童中，社会经济地位与饮食质量之间的正相关关系显著减弱。因此，我们得出结论：学校午餐可能有助于缩小饮食质量方面的社会经济差距。未来研究应探讨这些改善是否有助于减少健康、教育及收入方面的更广泛不平等。政策制定者在围绕（免费）学校午餐供应的持续讨论中，应考虑这些潜在益处。

title: Welfare‐enhancing, time‐consistent environmental policies in fixed‐numbers and free‐entry oligopolies
title_zh: 固定数量与自由进入寡头市场中福利增进且时间一致的环境政策
title_primary: 固定数量与自由进入寡头市场中福利增进且时间一致的环境政策
title_secondary: Welfare‐enhancing, time‐consistent environmental policies in fixed‐numbers and free‐entry oligopolies
authors: Debasmita Basak, Emmanuel Petrakis, Anastasios Xepapadeas
official: 官方在线 2026-05-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines how the government's ability to commit, or not, to a specific emission tax level impacts environmental innovation and social welfare in fixed‐numbers and free‐entry oligopolies. We show that when the market is relatively concentrated, emission taxes are lower, while environmental innovation, profits and welfare are higher, under a time‐consistent policy than under a precommitment policy. Conversely, when the market concentration is relatively low, the rankings reverse. Furthermore, considering a free‐entry oligopoly, we show that there are still conditions under which the time‐consistent policy fosters higher environmental innovation and social welfare than a precommitment policy, even though the number of firms entering the market are higher under a time‐consistent emission tax. Therefore, contrary to prevailing beliefs, we show that the government's commitment to a policy may result in higher emissions and lower social welfare.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了政府在固定数量与自由进入寡头市场中，对特定排放税水平承诺或不承诺的能力如何影响环境创新与社会福利。我们证明，在市场相对集中时，时间一致性政策下的排放税较低，而环境创新、利润和福利则高于预先承诺政策。相反，当市场集中度相对较低时，上述排序发生逆转。此外，考虑自由进入的寡头市场，我们表明，即使时间一致性排放税下进入市场的企业数量更多，仍存在条件使得时间一致性政策比预先承诺政策促进更高的环境创新和社会福利。因此，与普遍认知相反，我们证明政府对政策的承诺可能导致更高的排放和更低的社会福利。

title: Improving childhood immunization through maternal support: Evidence from a randomized intervention in Pakistan
title_zh: 通过母亲支持改善儿童免疫接种：来自巴基斯坦随机干预项目的证据

authors: Adeline Delavande, Areeba Shahab, Javed Younas, Basit Zafar
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-16 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We evaluate the effectiveness of randomized interventions aimed at alleviating behavioral barriers—such as maternal stress and psychological strain, limited future-oriented thinking, and information frictions—for early childhood immunization uptake in a sample of Pakistani mothers with infants. A phone-delivered intervention providing light psychological support as well as visualization and planning techniques increases the total number of vaccines received by young children by 0.3, or 7% of the control mean, one year after baseline. We also find that the intervention improves maternal knowledge, attitudes, and perceived returns to vaccination. However, supplementing this intervention with vaccination-related information from influencers does not yield additional benefits in this context.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了旨在缓解行为障碍（如母亲压力和心理紧张、有限的未来导向思维以及信息摩擦）的随机干预措施，在巴基斯坦有婴儿的母亲样本中对早期儿童免疫接种的有效性。一项通过电话提供的干预，包括轻度心理支持以及可视化和规划技巧，在基线一年后，使幼儿接种疫苗的总次数增加了0.3次，相当于对照组平均值的7%。我们还发现，该干预改善了母亲的知识、态度以及对疫苗接种的感知回报。然而，在此背景下，补充来自影响者的疫苗接种相关信息并未带来额外益处。

title: Examining the Impact of Government Input Support on Rice Production in Vietnam
title_zh: 政府投入支持对越南水稻生产影响的实证研究
title_primary: 政府投入支持对越南水稻生产影响的实证研究
title_secondary: Examining the Impact of Government Input Support on Rice Production in Vietnam
authors: Keo Sa Rate Thach, Ji Yong Lee, My Trang Ha, Minh Tuan Cao, Duyen Thi Le Chau 等
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-04-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: ABSTRACT Although rice production plays a vital role in Vietnam's economy, rice farmers' incomes remain low compared to other sectors. Several support policies have been introduced to improve this, including input support policies. This study examines the effect of input support on production outcomes of rice farmers using endogenous switching regression (ESR) analysis and propensity score matching (PSM) with data from the Vietnam Household Living Standards Survey (VHLSS) in 2018 and 2020. Findings show that households receiving input support had lower rice production efficiency and incomes than comparable households not receiving the support. While there is a link between support value and production outcomes, the impact is limited if support values are low. This suggests that small amounts of support are insufficient to improve production outcomes. Given our results, the Vietnam government should increase the support budget and focus on providing quality inputs. Additionally, rather than giving small cash amounts to individual households, which are insufficient to buy modern machinery, the government should invest in shared community‐level equipment to improve production capacity.
abstract_zh: 摘要 尽管水稻生产在越南经济中扮演着至关重要的角色，但稻农的收入与其他行业相比仍然偏低。为改善这一状况，政府已出台多项扶持政策，其中包括投入品支持政策。本研究利用2018年和2020年越南家庭生活水平调查（VHLSS）数据，采用内生转换回归（ESR）分析和倾向得分匹配（PSM）方法，考察投入品支持对稻农生产成果的影响。研究发现，接受投入品支持的家庭，其水稻生产效率及收入均低于未接受支持的同类家庭。尽管支持价值与生产成果之间存在关联，但当支持金额较低时，其影响有限。这表明，小额支持不足以改善生产成果。基于研究结果，越南政府应增加支持预算，并着重提供优质投入品。此外，与其向个体家庭发放不足以购买现代机械的小额现金，政府应投资于社区层面的共享设备，以提升生产能力。

title_primary: 《将就：英国人与战后世界的重塑》
title_secondary: Making Do: Britons and the Refashioning of the Postwar World. Susan Carruthers, (Cambridge University press, 2025. Pp. 400. ISBN 9781009464284. HbK £25).
authors: Jim Tomlinson
official: 官方在线 2026-04-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Susan Carrruthers has written a splendid book. Picking up on the wartime slogan of ‘Make Do and Mend’, she shows how much more we can understand about Britain in the 1940s by starting with the textiles, clothing, and footwear of the times. These products – perishable, threadbare after years of war, and chronically scarce – were critical to the ‘starting over’ that followed this calamitous conflict. As she argues, material stuff such as clothes and shoes and blankets and bedding were pivotal to the refashioning of relationships within the British Isles, as between Britons and others they encountered both at home and overseas: U.S. troops ‘over here’, British GI brides ‘over there’, service personnel from Britain's colonies, survivors of Nazi camps, and displaced persons and immigrants.
abstract_zh: 苏珊·卡拉瑟斯撰写了一部精彩之作。她借用了战时口号“修修补补，物尽其用”，展示了从当时的纺织品、服装和鞋履入手，我们能对20世纪40年代的英国有更深刻的理解。这些产品——历经战争岁月而磨损破旧、长期稀缺易损——对于这场灾难性冲突后的“重新开始”至关重要。正如她所言，衣物、鞋履、毯子和寝具等物质用品，在不列颠群岛内部人际关系的重塑中起到了关键作用，也影响了英国人与国内外相遇的他者之间的关系：驻扎此地的美军士兵、远在海外的英国新娘、来自英国殖民地的军人、纳粹集中营的幸存者，以及流离失所者和移民。

title: Evidence Gathering Under Competitive and Noncompetitive Rewards
title_zh: 竞争与非竞争性奖励下的证据收集
title_primary: 竞争与非竞争性奖励下的证据收集
title_secondary: Evidence Gathering Under Competitive and Noncompetitive Rewards
authors: Philip Brookins, Jennifer Brown, Dmitry Ryvkin
official: 官方在线 2026-03-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Reward schemes may affect not only agents' effort but also their incentives to gather information in order to reduce the riskiness of the productive activity. In a laboratory experiment using a novel task, we find that the relationship between incentives and evidence gathering depends critically on the availability of information about peers' strategies and outcomes. When no peer information is available, competitive rewards are associated with more evidence gathering than noncompetitive rewards. In contrast, when decision-makers know what or how their peers are doing, competitive rewards schemes are associated with less active evidence gathering than noncompetitive schemes. The nature of the feedback—whether subjects receive information about peers' strategies, outcomes, or both—also affects subjects' incentives to engage in evidence gathering. Specifically, only combined feedback about peers' strategies and performance—from which subjects may assess the overall relationship between evidence gathering, riskiness, and success—is associated with less evidence gathering when rewards are based on relative performance; we find no similar effect for noncompetitive rewards.
abstract_zh: 奖励方案不仅可能影响代理人的努力程度，还可能影响他们收集信息以降低生产活动风险的动机。在一项采用新颖任务的实验室实验中，我们发现激励与证据收集之间的关系关键取决于关于同伴策略和结果信息的可获得性。当没有同伴信息时，竞争性奖励比非竞争性奖励与更多的证据收集相关联。相反，当决策者了解同伴在做什么或如何做时，竞争性奖励方案与非竞争性方案相比，与较少的主动证据收集相关联。反馈的性质——受试者是否收到关于同伴策略、结果或两者的信息——也影响受试者参与证据收集的动机。具体而言，只有结合同伴策略和表现的反馈——受试者据此可评估证据收集、风险性与成功之间的整体关系——才与基于相对表现的奖励下较少的证据收集相关联；对于非竞争性奖励，我们未发现类似效应。

title: Misleading Advertising and Customer Recognition
title_zh: 误导性广告与客户识别
title_primary: 误导性广告与客户识别
title_secondary: Misleading Advertising and Customer Recognition
authors: Stefano Colombo, Luigi Filippini, Aldo Pignataro
official: 官方在线 2026-01-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In a two-period model of behaviour-based price discrimination, we consider the strategic incentives of competing oligopolistic firms in creating false expectations about the horizontal attributes of the products. In the case of exogenous real locations, we show that misleading advertising is profitable for firms as long as the equilibrium advertised product differentiation is greater than the real one. We also show that when firms adopt misleading advertising, behaviour-based price discrimination might increase the profits with respect to uniform pricing. When the real locations are endogenously chosen by firms, misleading advertising yields lower real product differentiation in equilibrium, but, due to the increase of the expected product differentiation, the final impact on the equilibrium profits is always positive. We also illustrate the implications of misleading advertising for consumer surplus and welfare, and we outline some policy prescriptions.
abstract_zh: 在行为性价格歧视的两期模型中，我们考察了竞争性寡头企业在制造关于产品水平属性的虚假预期方面的战略动机。在真实位置外生给定的情况下，我们证明，只要均衡广告中的产品差异化程度大于实际差异化程度，误导性广告对企业而言就是有利可图的。我们还表明，当企业采用误导性广告时，相对于统一定价，行为性价格歧视可能会增加利润。当真实位置由企业内生选择时，误导性广告在均衡中导致较低的真实产品差异化，但由于预期产品差异化的增加，对均衡利润的最终影响始终是正面的。我们还阐述了误导性广告对消费者剩余和社会福利的影响，并概述了一些政策建议。

title: User Innovation and Product Stickiness: Evidence From Video Games
title_zh: 用户创新与产品粘性：来自视频游戏的证据
title_primary: 用户创新与产品粘性：来自视频游戏的证据
title_secondary: User Innovation and Product Stickiness: Evidence From Video Games
authors: Yunfei Wang, Peng Huang
official: 官方在线 2025-09-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: ABSTRACT Prior research on user innovation fails to explain its low adoption rate and neglects its impact on increased product stickiness. To bridge these gaps, we conducted an empirical investigation into user innovations within the video game sector. Our study reveals that embracing user innovation leads to an upsurge in the number of active players for a game. Furthermore, the marginal effect of user innovations varies depending on their recency and quality , with low‐quality user innovations leading to user attrition. The effect is also contingent on the stage in the product life cycle in which user innovation is adopted.
abstract_zh: 摘要 先前关于用户创新的研究未能解释其低采纳率，并忽视了其对产品粘性增强的影响。为弥补这些空白，我们对视频游戏行业的用户创新进行了实证调查。研究发现，采纳用户创新能显著提升游戏的活跃玩家数量。此外，用户创新的边际效应因其新颖性和质量而异，低质量的用户创新会导致用户流失。该效应还取决于用户创新被采纳时所处的产品生命周期阶段。

title: Estimating how firm characteristics affect corruption using enterprise survey data
title_zh: 使用企业调查数据估计企业特征如何影响腐败
title_primary: 使用企业调查数据估计企业特征如何影响腐败
title_secondary: Estimating how firm characteristics affect corruption using enterprise survey data
authors: George R.G. Clarke PNC Distinguished Chair and Professor of Economics, Division of International Banking and Finance Studies, A.R. Sanchez, Jr. School of Business, Texas A&M International University, Laredo, TX 等
official: 官方在线 2025-06-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The World Bank Enterprise Surveys contain multiple questions pertaining to corruption. One popular question asks how much firms typically pay in bribes. The manager can answer in two ways: as a per cent of sales or in local currency. In principle, the reported amount should not depend upon how the manager chooses to answer. In practice, it does. Those opting to answer as percentages report paying far more than managers opting to answer in local currency in most countries. This article proposes a new method for estimating the discrepancy and other parameters taking this into account. Hypothesis tests consistently favour the modified model over the basic model that does not control for the different reporting methods.
abstract_zh: 世界银行企业调查包含多个与腐败相关的问题。其中一个常见问题询问企业通常支付多少贿赂。管理者可以以两种方式回答：按销售额的百分比或按当地货币金额。原则上，报告金额不应取决于管理者选择如何回答。然而在实践中，情况并非如此。在大多数国家，选择以百分比回答的管理者报告支付的金额远高于选择以当地货币回答的管理者。本文提出了一种新方法，用于估计这一差异及其他参数，并对此加以考虑。假设检验一致地支持修正模型，而非未控制不同报告方式的基本模型。
